---
name: Bug report
about: Report a bug or unexpected behavior in DisplayFlip
title: '[Bug] '
labels: bug
---

## Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Current display state (e.g., 2 monitors extended, Solo 1, Duplicate)
2. Action taken (e.g., Tray menu, Hotkey, Settings UI, CLI)
3. Actual behavior vs expected behavior

## Environment
- Windows version (e.g., Windows 11 24H2)
- DisplayFlip version (e.g., v1.0.0 Standalone or Framework-Dependent)
- Monitor setup (e.g., 2x 1920x1080, mixed DPI)

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.
